question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

Hopefully, I __will have got__ my driving license by the end of this year.
solution:
The correct answer is **No improvement required. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence has **no errors** in it.
 
• When we are looking back from a future point in time, the modal verb **"will have"** is used.
 
• The sentence is in the **future perfect tense.**
 
• Structure of future perfect tense:** Subject + will have + past participle + Object.** 
 
 
• **Example:** *By night, I will have finished my homework.*
 
 
 
• *​*The given sentence is grammatically correct. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The tenses only serve to convey the passage of time.
 
• **The "Future Perfect Tense" is used to represent an action that is anticipated to be finished before a specific future time.**
